newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 11.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* Warner Bros estimated its Mel Gibson-Julia Roberts thriller, Conspiracy Theory, brought in $19.4 million for the weekend, while Sony estimated Air Force One brought in $18.2 million.

* Jonathan Hensleigh, who wrote "The Rock" and Touchstone's upcoming summer 1998 event film "Armageddon," will make his feature film directorial debut with one of his own scripts, "Hulk," for Universal Pictures.
* United Artists Theatre Circuit Inc will spend $175 million in the next three years building 450 new screens.
* Tele-Communications Inc on Friday reported a 16 percent increase in cash flow to $706 million on 7 percent higher revenue of $1.6 billion.
* Universal Concerts has purchased Denver-based Fey Concerts, the region's top concert promotion firm.
* Arista Records has tapped Matthew Walden West Coast senior vice president and given the Fox studio executive a mandate to increase the label's ties to film and TV studios.
